sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
This card's combat stats make it be like the upgraded version of [[TCG:SAS-025|Ammit Heart-Eater: Rassimov's Pet]] and [[TCG:SAS-037|Janus Knight: Dark Charger]]. With 2 attack more than Ammmit Heart-Eater, it can even defeat [[TCG:SAS-001|Caliban: Dante's Titan]]! You don't need to Exhaust or discard a card to play this version of [[Dominator/TCG|Dominator]] so that is a huge advantage, you can replace it with [[TCG:OAL-025|Shakrit: Ancient Dragon]] who has 6 defence, but then you have to exhaust a target friendly hero once it comes in play or with [[TCG:SAS-050|Ymir: Frost Giant]] who has the same attack and defence but has a very useful ability (although you will have to discard a card to play this card.
